meta.match_rules: plan.md §4.2: tier 1 same 3-digit CPV class, tier 2 same 2-digit division, tier 3 any 35*; supplier has ≥1 award in division 35; overall median award within 0.2×–5× budget; ordered by tier, then match.py score (10·ln(1+wins in 5-digit group) + 2·ln(1+other wins in 3-digit class) +3 same buyer +1 local +1 active in last 12 months); at most 2 per country
meta.limit_rules: plan.md §4.3: buyer walk_away_eur = published estimated value × 1.10; supplier floor_eur per CPV class = min priced award in the class × size margin (small 0.9, medium 0.85, large 0.8). At match time the server sets the thread floor = max(offer floor_eur, 0.6 × demand estimated_value_eur) and skips the match when that floor exceeds walk_away_eur. All limits are sealed: stored, enforced, never returned. candidates[].price_low/high are legacy band hints; the agent chooses its own ask
meta.bom_rules: personas[] with bom_id: suppliers for the lines of demo_bom.csv, lots of ted:604012-2026 that drew no tenders. They are the winners of its other lots whose persona classes (top 2 by wins) share a line's CPV division with a floor within the line's walk-away. That notice's awards are restated per lot from its TED result, PLN at the ECB rate of 2026-10-29 (4.3938) instead of market.db's equal split
